Class RegistrationValidator

java.lang.Object
com.cab302.vic.service.RegistrationValidator
public final class RegistrationValidator extends Object
Checks a registration form before it is sent to AuthService. Every problem is reported at once, keyed by the field it belongs to, so the screen can show each message next to the right field instead of one message at a time at the bottom of the form. Has no JavaFX dependency so it can be unit tested directly.

      public static Map<RegistrationValidator.Field, String> validate(String username, String fullName, String email, String password, String confirmPassword)
      Validates every field of the registration form.
      Parameters:
      username - the username entered
      fullName - the full name entered
      email - the email entered
      password - the password entered
      confirmPassword - the repeated password
      Returns:
      a map from each invalid field to its error message, in form order; empty when the form is valid

    • passwordChecklist

      public static String passwordChecklist(String password)
      Builds the live password checklist shown under the password field, marking each rule as met or not met.
      Parameters:
      password - the password typed so far (may be null)
      Returns:
      a one-line checklist, with a tick or a cross in front of each rule
